instrument: Oklahoma HB 2992, Data Center Consumer Ratepayer Protection Act
summary: Creates a large-load class at 75 MW or more and imposes a $1,500-per-day penalty for failing to notify nearby landowners and officials within 60 days of a land purchase.
notes: Signed May 11 2026 per the Cherokee Nation task force report; a cited Oklahoma Voice piece is dated April 21. Pull the enrolled bill.
confidence_note: Relayed through the Cherokee Nation task force report and secondary coverage.

source.citation: Cherokee Nation Data Center Task Force Report (June 30 2026); Oklahoma Voice
